name: 個別会話の共有物と保存方針パネル
prompt:
Create one clean, high-fidelity Japanese iOS settings-list component. Use the attached original WhatsApp screenshot crop as the controlling reference for row geometry, icon artwork, card surfaces, separators, spacing, and colors. Use the Japanese native preview for exact Japanese copy and the 390×514 target canvas.

The isolated screen contains only three grouped white rounded cards on a very light gray #F5F5F5 page. No header, avatar, action buttons, status bar, WhatsApp/Mobbin footer, home indicator, or extra title. The black home-indicator bar visible at the bottom edge of the source crop is a phone overlay; remove it entirely.

Use exactly these seven rows and no additional text:
Card 1:
1) photo/image outline icon; label 「写真・リンク・資料」; right value 「3件」; gray chevron.
2) outlined star; label 「保存したメッセージ」; right value 「なし」; gray chevron.
Card 2:
3) outlined notification bell; label 「通知」; right value 「設定する」; gray chevron.
4) artist palette icon from the original screenshot; label 「会話の背景」; right value 「設定する」; gray chevron.
5) save-to-photos tray-and-arrow icon from the original screenshot; label 「写真に保存」; right value 「保存しない」; gray chevron.
Card 3:
6) disappearing-messages timer icon from the original screenshot; label 「消えるメッセージ」; right value 「オフ」; gray chevron.
7) document outline icon from the original screenshot; label 「文字起こしの言語」; smaller subtitle 「日本語」 below the label; right value 「設定」; gray chevron.

Keep labels near-black #1D1D1D in Meiryo Regular around 14px/20px. Supporting values and subtitle are medium gray #6E6E6E around 12px/16px. Chevron strokes and separators are light gray; use thin inset separators only between rows within each card. Preserve the original source's icon silhouettes and stroke weight rather than substituting the native preview placeholders. Keep card corners soft and subtle, with a modest gray gap between the three groups.

None of these text nodes is a hyperlink. 「リンク」 is simply part of the first navigation-row label, which ends in a chevron. Do not color that word blue. Use blue #2563EB only for text that is an actual hyperlink; no actual hyperlinks appear here, so this component has no blue text.

Fit the design to a vertical 390×514 canvas without stretching icons or glyphs. Preserve the source crop's row proportions and use extra height as vertical breathing room between card groups and outer margins. Crisp, flat, readable interface; no gradients, shadows, texture, or photographic rendering.
reviewNotes: First candidate: Japanese copy and original icons are accurate; first card vertical placement and subtle surface texture need correction.
